registration: Commit tested protocol and source before the new exclusion gate. Completed attention has already been inspected. These are prospective one-target causal interventions within an already-studied cohort, not unseen-data generalization.
attention_review: Source16 full CPU run completed with W&B delivery:21 promptable sequences/2012 targets. Four-layer/all-query exp(median sequence log enrichment): primary BG0.70197/FG3.55941/boundary9.33868. All settled definitions have BG<1 and FG/boundary>1. Allocation does not establish usefulness and does not determine which outcomes are retained.
label_source: Reuse each frame's own saved native-memory assignments from completed source16. Match checkpoint/manifest/CPU/runtime/base-engine identity and native prediction hashes. No changed region definitions or new probes. GT only initializes the single prompt and evaluates outcomes.
cohort: All23 source IDs; seq1/7 unpromptable N/A. All2012 postprompt targets across21 promptable sequences. Every settled definition/region runs regardless of effect direction. Old trimaps3/7 remain attention/geometry diagnostics, not this amended causal claim.
engine: Official pinned external/sam2, SAM2.1 B+, CPU FP32/no autocast, native BF16 memory, no postprocessing, memory stride1; same source16 baseline. No replacement encoder/decoder/attention or memory policy.
intervention: Cache the target's native image features and pre-target output bank. Reuse official _run_single_frame_inference with run_mem_encoder=False on fresh container copies, sharing read-only tensors. Apply a contiguous full-shape additive mask at native SDPA in all4 cross-attention layers. Selected spatial keys get -infinity, others/pointers0. Never remove/reorder Q/K/V, change RoPE or write intervention outputs back. Native propagation remains the sole trajectory.

contiguity_null.operator: Within each actual retained memory frame, crop the selected binary64 mask to its bounding rectangle; form unique D4 orientations via torch.rot90/torch.flip; enumerate all fitting integer translations on the64x64 plane. Sample uniformly over unique nonidentity placements. No toroidal wrap, clipping, shape synthesis or best-of-N selection.
contiguity_null.preserves: Exact excluded count, component shapes/sizes,4-connected component area multiset and4-neighbor perimeter, separately in each memory frame; same temporal positions/pointers. Masks remain same-shape contiguous additive SDPA tensors, including the explicit zero-mask numerical control.
contiguity_null.sampling: Three fixed seeded replicates, averaged never selected. Deterministic context=sequence|target|stored_frame|regional-mask-hash. Identical masks across definitions receive identical nulls and can reuse identical counterfactual scores. Replicates can coincide in small orbits; report candidate counts and duplicate mask hashes, never treat them as independent experimental units.
contiguity_null.overlap: Controls may overlap the true region; record overlap per frame. Disjoint BG nulls are generally impossible. Position and image-border proximity are not matched; this tests spatial specificity against a rigid-placement null, not semantic purity or anatomy-controlled causality.
contiguity_null.invariant: Empty or rigidly invariant masks have0 nonidentity candidates and are left identical in each replicate, explicitly reported as unrandomizable. Primary eligible target for a definition/region requires at least1 informative retained memory frame and some excluded keys. Do not fabricate a matched control or force these cases into primary inference.
contiguity_null.all_keys: If exclusion would remove every attention key including absence of usable pointers, the condition is undefined and reported, not approximated by leaving an arbitrary key.

implementation_provenance: Null randomization is project experimental-control integration using unchanged PyTorch transforms and OpenCV connectedComponentsWithStats, not a claimed published SAM2 algorithm. Native state-copy, hashing, scoring and counterfactual pattern are reused from the retained exclusion runner.
numerical_checks: Native propagation must match completed source16 hashes on every postprompt frame. Cached native no-op must be bit-identical before/after interventions. Explicit full-shape all-zero additive-mask control must also be bit-identical. Q/K/V shape/stride/dtype/device must match native; pointers unchanged; all4 layers observed. Exact bank/target/image-cache tensor digests before/after; run_mem_encoder=False and encoder invocation forbidden. Frozen parameters checked each sequence. Any failed check stops execution, dated corrective commit then gate rerun.

gate.coverage: All73 native postprompt predictions must match; exclusions on these6 fixed targets, all6 definitions/3 regions/3 controls. Frame choices are positional, not outcome-selected. Full run requires matching committed sources/protocol/device/checkpoint and confirmed gate delivery.

summary.primary_endpoint: Present-GT targets with informative valid controls, averaged per sequence. Loss=baselineDice-regionExcludedDice. Excess loss=mean(3 rigid-control Dice)-regionExcludedDice; positive means region-specific harm beyond the spatial null. Sequence is the unit; average controls within target then targets within sequence, never pool all frames as independent samples.
summary.primary_tests: 18 fixed definition x region comparisons, paired two-sided Wilcoxon on sequence regional loss versus matched-control loss, Holm across all18; alpha0.05. Whole-sequence10000 bootstrap95 CI of mean excess loss using retained evaluation.statistics implementation. Report N/eligibility; no pseudoreplication from seeds or tokens.
summary.go_no_go: A definition-robust regional effect requires positive mean excessDice loss, positive95 CI lower bound and Holm18 p<0.05 for that region in ALL6 settled definitions. Otherwise report no demonstrated robust effect/definition dependence. At least one qualifying region supports a cohort-specific regional spatial effect, not a deployable segmentation gain. Do not weaken this rule after outcomes.
summary.secondary: IoU and Boundary F descriptive; all/present/absent, fixed size quartiles from source16, complete-miss versus overlap-present and absent correct-empty/false-positive strata from the native baseline. No tuned Dice threshold, no secondary confirmatory p-values.
summary.limitations: One-step conditional on the unchanged native bank, not full counterfactual propagation; candidate invariance/overlap and eligibility can reduce power. Patient independence unverified; same previously inspected cohort. Attention enrichment alone is not a causal result.

execution: Gate then full automatically if integrity/delivery pass; all6 definitions retained even for unexpected outcomes. Exact identical key masks may share cached scores within the SAME target/state only. Store hashes, transformations/counts/overlap, eligibility, all scores and integrity receipts; fixed first-postprompt illustrations only. Outputs/caches on mounted Drive, mandatory online W&B. Record gate runtime projection before full run; no promise of completion in minutes.
stopping_rule: Stop only for correctness/resource/delivery failure, not because effect signs oppose the hypothesis. No source/definition/summary changes after launch except fixing a demonstrated check failure with a dated corrective commit and rerun gate.
